171:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You both did well. You stirred the emotions of $$ハマーン・カーン$$, the so-called Iron Lady...」

171:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That produced 50Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

171:t_10:11.en:
$$クェス$$
「Haha! Even that can produce $$Ｚチップ$$s!」

171:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「People like her keep so much bottled up inside. When their emotions explode, they produce quite pure $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

171:t_10:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So that's how it works...」

171:t_10:14.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then maybe I'll make $$ハマーン$$ even angrier next time we fight.」

171:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, I'll teach you some of my best trash talk.」

171:t_10:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I-if you did that, no number of lives would be enough!」

171:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm pleased to meet you, $$セツコ$$. I'm $$ＡＧ$$, $$ＤＥＭ$$'s agent robot.」

171:t_10:22.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I-it's nice to meet you, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$...」

171:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, $$セツコ$$...! There's no need to be polite to the likes of me. Just spit out '$$ＡＧ$$!' with contempt.」

171:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my... What's wrong? You're trembling like your old self.」

171:t_10:26.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$シン$$ told me I should stay away from you...」

171:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And yet you've come to see me. You must be fascinated by my lovable body.」

171:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now... As a member of $c, $$セツコ$$, there's something you have to do.」

171:t_10:30.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Even $$シン$$ didn't tell me about that...」

171:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then lend me your ear... I'll tell you in secret.」

171:t_10:32.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Does it need to be secret?」

171:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$セツコ$$... Are you saying a newcomer like you won't listen to a senior member?」

171:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You have the right stuff... That's a fine answer.」

171:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies...! My exhaust port happened to be pointing right at your lovely ear...」

171:t_10:39.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...That's enough! I've finished introducing myself, so I'll be leaving now!」

171:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Ah...! Please wait, $$セツコ$$! $$セツコ$$!!」

171:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems I went a little too far. I'll reflect on that.」

171:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, to everyone who was looking forward to it, I'm sorry. I'll be doing today's sales pitch myself!」

171:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, let's give it our all today... Business, business!」

172:t_000:1.en:
$$シン$$
「$$アスラン$$ and the others are with her. They should have gotten her somewhere safe by now.」

172:t_000:3.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ザフト$$ has gone completely over to $$ネオ・ジオン$$. When I opposed that, they tried to detain me.」

172:t_000:4.en:
$$シン$$
「But not everyone in $$プラント$$ wants war. $$ラクス$$ is one of them, of course.」

172:t_000:5.en:
$$シン$$
「After I deserted $$ザフト$$, I joined people trying to preserve peace and waited for a chance to fight back.」

172:t_000:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Watch out! Mobile suits are coming out of $$プラント$$!」

172:t_001:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Apparently, $$フル・フロンタル$$ has been working to bring $$プラント$$ into his forces since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

172:t_001:4.en:
$n
「$$ヒイロ$$, $$デュオ$$, and the others didn't bring their machines! We have to buy time until they can get out!」

172:t_001:5.en:
$$シン$$
「$$キラ$$! Are you going to let $$ラクス$$'s wishes end here?!」

172:t_001:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's fight for $$ラクス$$, too, $$キラ$$...!」

172:t_002:2.en:
$n
「$$シン$$! I'll cover $$キラ$$! Will you be all right over there?!」

172:t_002:3.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't worry. $$ルナ$$ is with me, too.」

172:t_002:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She's $$ルナマリア$$, $$シン$$'s girlfriend.」

172:t_002:6.en:
$n
「He's fighting for what he cares about, too...」

172:t_002:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n... You've sorted out your feelings about Ensign $$リディ$$.)

172:t_002:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「$c will be here soon...! We have to hold out on our own until then!」

172:t_002:13.en:
$n
(I don't really understand how you felt fighting for $$オードリー$$, but $$キラ$$, $$シン$$, and I all have things we care about...!)

172:t_004:2.en:
$$ファ$$
「$$ルナマリア$$ is here, too!」

172:t_004:3.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「It's been a while, $$ファ$$. Leave babysitting $$シン$$ to me.」

172:t_004:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has already infiltrated $$プラント$$.」

172:t_004:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「But there aren't that many! Let's finish them off and show $$プラント$$ how pointless it is to ally with $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

172:t_004:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「When we infiltrated $$プラント$$, I got the feeling this isn't a problem we can solve that easily.」

172:t_004:12.en:
$$シン$$
「We'll talk later! First, we'll get through this and rescue $$ラクス$$!」

172:t_004:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, deploy! We're taking down the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces stationed in $$プラント$$!」

172:t_004:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But be careful. Don't expect this battle to end so easily!」
